prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. One event picture for Hearts of Iron IV Equestria at War STG. Reference sheet is visual style only: painted cartoon ponies embedded in a convincing archival documentary scene, short equine muzzles, expressive large eyes, pony ears, quadruped proportions. Period photograph look, sepia or faded desaturated colour as the scene requires, film grain, subtle vignette, clear composition readable at 210x176. Full bleed rectangular landscape aspect 210:176, target 1050x880, no tilted borders or labels. ALL figures are ponies (earth ponies, pegasi, unicorns) unless the scene names another creature, NEVER humans, no fingers. All characters original. No captions, lettering, text, numbers, logos, watermark.  Reference is visual style only. All characters original, never real people or canonical MLP characters. No human anatomy, no fingers. Any books, flags, posters or banknotes contain only abstract blank forms, never writing. Creature exceptions named in the scene take precedence over ponies-only: griffons, zebra, draconequus, cat, diamond dog, dove as specified. One image, no collage or panels. Scene: A theatre stage: an original draconequus magician in a checked jacket with a large cat and a lanky companion, banknotes falling from the ceiling over the audience. 1930s photo.
Targeted correction: Edit ONLY the central draconequus magician in this exact illustration to be a CLEARLY ORIGINAL chimera character and NOT Discord or any existing MLP character. Preserve the theatre, pony audience, tall pony assistant, large cat, falling abstract blank banknotes, sepia archival texture, lighting and composition. New magician design: broad short reptilian muzzle, round spectacles, dark curly cheek fur, two SHORT symmetric curled ram horns (NO deer antler), short feather crest, compact curled serpentine tail, two small symmetrical folded feathered wings, confident elderly theatrical expression, original dark-and-light checked jacket. Do NOT use Discord's long thin grey face, asymmetric antler and goat horn, signature beard or mismatched bat/feather wings. Both limbs ending at sleeves should be compact rounded LION PAWS with paws closed, NO splayed hands or long fingers, no human hands. The magician presents the flying banknotes by magical glow rather than finger gestures. This is a chimera, not a human. Banknotes must remain abstract oval shapes on blank paper without letters or numbers. No text, watermark or captions.
postprocessing: Lanczos resize to specified master and game dimensions. DDS DXT5 with alpha, no mipmaps.
